containers.removeDescription: The container is removed from this server. Named volumes are not deleted.

images.pruned: {count, plural, one {# dangling image} other {# dangling images}} deleted, {size} freed
images.empty: There are no images on this server yet.
images.aooxHint: An aoox image (helper, panel, or rollback). Clean it up from Docker Disk.
images.removeDescription: Deletion applies per image ID ({id}), so all tags of this image are removed from this server. Pull it again from the registry if needed.
